dict.string: Apple Watch needs this to show your heart rate during a Workout. Temper saves no workouts to Health, and sends none of your data anywhere.
Temper reads your heart rate during a Workout, and your date of birth and resting heart rate to work out your heart-rate zones. It keeps all of it on your iPhone and Apple Watch.
Temper listens while you describe a Workout and turns your words into text on this iPhone. Nothing you say leaves it.
